# canvasquiz

The canvasquiz package provides functions to interact with the Canvas
LMS API, specifically for constructing quizzes and retrieving quiz data.
This package allows you to write the quizzes in R and directly push them
to Canvas, as well as retrieve quiz statistics and results for analysis.

Note that this package only supports Classic Quizzes in Canvas, not New
Quizzes.

## Installation

You can install the development version of canvasquiz from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("emitanaka/canvasquiz")
```

## Usage

``` r
library(canvasquiz)
```

### Set environment variables

In the R environment, you can set the following environment variables to
avoid having to specify them in each function call:

``` r
Sys.setenv(CANVASQUIZ_COURSE_ID = "your_course_id")
Sys.setenv(CANVASQUIZ_URL = "https://your_canvas_instance.instructure.com")
Sys.setenv(CANVASQUIZ_TOKEN = "your_access_token")
```

Or set this in your `.Renviron` file for persistence across sessions.
You can use the `usethis` package to edit your `.Renviron` file:

``` r
usethis::edit_r_environ()
```

The URL is the base URL of your Canvas instance, e.g. at ANU it is
`https://canvas.anu.edu.au`.

The access token can be generated in your Canvas account settings under
“Approved Integrations”.

The course ID can be found in the URL of your course in Canvas. For
example if your course URL is `https://canvas.anu.edu.au/courses/12345`,
then the course ID is `12345`.

### Creating a quiz

``` r
qid <- create_quiz(title = "Quiz 1", 
                   description = "This assessment is 30 minutes with only one attempt.",
                   quiz_type = "practice_quiz",
                   attempts = attempt_options(n = 1, time = 30))
```

The output will be the quiz ID of the newly created quiz. Use this quiz
ID to add questions to the quiz. If the quiz ID is not specified, the
question will be added to the most recently created quiz.

#### Numerical question

The exact value match:

``` r
create_question("What is 2 + 2?",
                answers = answer_num(4),
                points = 1,
                quiz_id = qid)
```

The value match with a tolerance:

``` r
create_question("What is the square root of 2?",
                answers = answer_num(sqrt(2), tol = 0.1),
                points = 1,
                quiz_id = qid)
```

The value match with a specified number of decimal places:

``` r
create_question("What is the square root of 2?",
                answers = answer_num_precision(sqrt(2), precision = 1),
                points = 1,
                quiz_id = qid)
```

The value match within a specified range:

``` r
create_question("What is the value of pi?",
                answers = answer_num_range(3.14, 3.15),
                points = 1,
                quiz_id = qid)
```

#### Multiple choice question

A multiple choice question with one correct answer:

``` r
create_question("Which of the following are prime numbers?",
                answers = answer_mcq("2", choices = c("2", "10", "12")),
                quiz_id = qid)
```

A multiple choice question with multiple correct answers:

``` r
create_question("Which of the following are prime numbers?",
                answers = answer_mcq(c("2", "3", "5"), choices = c("2", "3", "4", "5")),
                quiz_id = qid)
```

#### True/False question

``` r
create_question("The Earth is flat.",
                answers = answer_true_false(FALSE),
                quiz_id = qid)
```

#### Short answer question

``` r
create_question("What is the capital of France?",
                answers = answer_text("Paris"),
                quiz_id = qid)
```

#### Essay question

``` r
create_question("Describe the process of photosynthesis.",
                answers = answer_essay(),
                quiz_id = qid)
```

#### Matching question

``` r
create_question("Match the following countries with their capitals.",
                answers = answer_matching(
                  left = c("France", "Japan", "Australia"),
                  right = c("Paris", "Tokyo", "Canberra"),
                  extra_choices = c("Madrid", "Beijing", "Wellington")
                ),
                quiz_id = qid)
```

#### Multiple answers

Selecting answers from multiple dropdowns:

``` r
create_question(
    "Roses are [color1], violets are [color2].",
    answers = answer_multiple(
      dropdown(
        choices = c("red", "blue", "yellow"),
        correct = "red",
        id = "color1"
      ),
      dropdown(
        choices = c("red", "blue", "yellow"),
        correct = "blue",
        id = "color2"
      )
    )
  )
```

Fill in the blanks:

``` r
create_question(
    "Roses are [color1], violets are [color2].",
    answers = answer_multiple(
      fill_in_the_blank("red", id = "color1"),
      fill_in_the_blank("blue", id = "color2")
    )
  )
```

#### Upload a file

``` r
create_question("Upload a file with your answer.",
                answers = answer_upload_file(),
                quiz_id = qid)
```

### Retrieving quiz data

Quiz statistics:

``` r
quiz_statistics(quiz_id = qid)
```

Quiz results with user information:

``` r
quiz_results(quiz_id = qid)
```

Question-level statistics:

``` r
quiz_submissions(quiz_id = qid)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_question_from_bank()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/add_question_from_bank.md)
  : Add questions from a question bank to a quiz
- [`answer_essay()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_essay.md)
  : Answer for an essay question
- [`answer_fill_in_multiple_blanks()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_fill_in_multiple_blanks.md)
  : Answer for a fill-in-multiple-blanks question
- [`answer_matching()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_matching.md)
  : Answer for a matching question
- [`answer_mcq()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_mcq.md)
  : Answer for a multiple choice question
- [`answer_multiple()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_multiple.md)
  : Multiple answer question
- [`answer_none()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_none.md)
  : A text-only question with no answers
- [`answer_num()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_num.md)
  [`answer_num_precision()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_num.md)
  [`answer_num_range()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_num.md)
  : A numerical answer question with an exact answer
- [`answer_single()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_single.md)
  : Create an answer object for a quiz question
- [`answer_text()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_text.md)
  : A short answer question
- [`answer_true_false()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_true_false.md)
  : True or False Question
- [`answer_upload_file()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/answer_upload_file.md)
  : A file upload question
- [`opt_show()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/attempt-options.md)
  [`opt_hide()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/attempt-options.md)
  [`opt_shuffle()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/attempt-options.md)
  : Options for showing quiz results or answers
- [`attempt_options()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/attempt_options.md)
  : A quiz attempt options
- [`set_canvas_course_id()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/canvas.md)
  [`get_canvas_course_id()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/canvas.md)
  [`set_canvas_url()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/canvas.md)
  [`get_canvas_url()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/canvas.md)
  [`set_canvas_token()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/canvas.md)
  [`get_canvas_token()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/canvas.md)
  : Set and get Canvas course, URL, and token
- [`count_submissions()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/count_submissions.md)
  : Count the number of quiz submissions
- [`create_question()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/create_question.md)
  : Create a Quiz Question
- [`create_quiz()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/create_quiz.md)
  : Create a Quiz
- [`delete_all_quizzes()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/delete_all_quizzes.md)
  : Delete all quizzes
- [`delete_quiz()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/delete_quiz.md)
  : Delete a quiz
- [`delete_quiz_question()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/delete_quiz_question.md)
  : Delete a quiz question
- [`dropdown()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/dropdown.md)
  : Create a dropdown answer for a fill-in-multiple-blanks question
- [`fill_in_the_blank()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/fill_in_the_blank.md)
  : Create a fill-in-the-blank answer for a fill-in-multiple-blanks
  question
- [`last_quiz_id()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/last-ids.md)
  [`last_question_id()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/last-ids.md)
  : Get the ID of the most recently created quiz in a course
- [`list_attempted_questions()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/list_attempted_questions.md)
  : List attempted questions for a quiz
- [`list_files()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/list_files.md)
  : List files in a folder or course
- [`list_folder()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/list_folder.md)
  : List the folder in a course
- [`list_pages()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/list_pages.md)
  : List pages in a course
- [`list_questions()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/list_questions.md)
  [`list_question_groups()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/list_questions.md)
  : List quiz questions in a course
- [`list_quizzes()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/list_quizzes.md)
  : List quizzes in a course
- [`list_submissions()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/list_submissions.md)
  : List quiz submissions
- [`md()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/md.md) : Convert
  Markdown to HTML
- [`quiz_questions()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/quiz_questions.md)
  : Get quiz questions
- [`quiz_results()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/quiz_results.md)
  : Quiz results with user information
- [`quiz_results_summary()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/quiz_results_summary.md)
  : Quiz results summary
- [`quiz_statistics()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/quiz_statistics.md)
  : Get quiz statistics
- [`quiz_submissions()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/quiz_submissions.md)
  : Get quiz submissions with question-level answers
- [`regrade_question()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/regrade_question.md)
  : Regrade quiz submissions based on answer
- [`submission_info()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/submission_info.md)
  : Get quiz submission details
- [`submission_overview()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/submission_overview.md)
  : Get quiz submission overview
- [`submission_questions()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/submission_questions.md)
  : List attempted questions for a quiz
- [`submission_update()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/submission_update.md)
  : Update a quiz submission
- [`update_question()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/update_question.md)
  : Update a quiz question
- [`upload_file()`](http://emitanaka.org/canvasquiz/reference/upload_file.md)
  : Upload a file to a folder
